assessment.label: Recommended action
assessment.text: Inject 7 is a desktop folder holding two applications. Do not open them and do not announce them as the cause. The folder name matches a zip already listed. The shown date does not. The public paragraph still awaits leader approval.

assessment.text: Blackout cause, authorized activity, source clocks, physical grid state, official deadline and time zone, presentation duration, and submission method. A judging-criteria photo is in the Drive folder; its example wording is not Whoville evidence.
